answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a concise bullet points, data-driven conclusions register, it stays short. What survives to the summit is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on on-chain governance with conviction voting. A prism of per-task receipts records who did what, and the orchard of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
